info.title: Barber Booking API
info.description: Contract documentation for implemented Barber Booking API routes. IDs, status codes, validation and response fields reflect the current Express controllers and Zod schemas. The API prefix is supplied by the server at runtime. JSON request bodies are limited to 1 MiB; malformed JSON returns 400 and oversized bodies return 413.

post.description: Public. The server assigns role USER. The Zod object schema does not opt into strict unknown-key rejection.
Public. The server assigns role BARBER. The Zod object schema does not opt into strict unknown-key rejection.
The Zod object schema does not opt into strict unknown-key rejection.

patch.description: Any authenticated role. Identity is taken from the token; unknown fields are rejected.

get.description: Public; Bearer authentication is optional. USER callers can receive isFavorite; anonymous and non-USER callers do not.

post.description: BARBER role. User ownership is derived from the authenticated token.

get.description: Public; optional authentication enriches the response with isFavorite for USER callers.
Public; optional authentication enriches the response with isFavorite for USER callers. Public selection excludes private user/account fields.

patch.description: Updates are scoped to the authenticated barber; foreign service IDs return not found.

put.summary: Create or replace current barber location
put.description: The barber is derived from the authenticated identity; request body has no barberId field.

get.summary: Get current user's favorite status for a barber

post.description: USER only. userId, endAt, status and service snapshot fields are server-controlled and rejected if supplied. Booking requires an active service, barber schedule, future time and non-overlapping slot.

get.description: A booking owned by another customer is returned as not found.

get.summary: Get queue position for own booking

patch.description: Request body must be an empty object. Cancellation is subject to booking start time and queue lifecycle rules.

post.description: Creates a new booking using the source booking's barber and service. Only startAt is accepted.

patch.summary: Mark all current user's notifications as read

patch.description: Notifications belonging to another user return not found.

post.description: User ownership is assigned by the server. A token already owned by another user returns 409.

delete.description: Device tokens belonging to another user return not found.

bearerAuth.description: Access token returned by register or login. Send as Authorization: Bearer <token>.

BarberDetails.description: Public barber details: id, businessName, bio, isVerified, isOpen, location, gallery, active services, workingHours and optional USER-only isFavorite. Public user/account fields are not selected.

ServiceResult.description: Service fields; price is serialized as a number

ServiceList.description: Services; public endpoint returns active service fields only

LocationResult.description: Location coordinates are serialized as numbers

BookingResult.description: Booking response. Customer views include a barber summary; barber views include a customer summary; shared booking properties include IDs, timestamps, status and nested service snapshot. Queue creation is persisted atomically but is not embedded in the create response.

QueueResult.description: Queue entry or customer queue position

NotificationResult.description: Notification object scoped to the authenticated user

data.title: Booking confirmed
data.message: Your appointment has been scheduled successfully.

DeviceTokenResult.description: Device token object scoped to the authenticated user. Token strings are sensitive and are returned only to their owner; do not expose them in client logs.

ValidationError.description: Validation failed (Zod issue paths and messages are returned in errors)

Unauthorized.description: Authentication required, invalid/expired JWT, or invalid login credentials

Forbidden.description: Authenticated role is not permitted for this operation

NotFound.description: Resource missing or outside the authenticated owner's scope

Conflict.description: Duplicate resource or business-rule conflict (exact message is operation/state dependent)

data.description: The controller returns null for this successful operation.

User.description: Safe user projection. passwordHash is never returned.

UserResponse.description: For /auth/me the user omits avatarUrl; profile update includes avatarUrl.

closeTime.description: Must be later than openTime on the same day.

userId.description: Included in create/cancel responses and BARBER views; omitted in customer booking reads.

user.description: Included in barber booking list responses.

position.description: Position among active entries, ordered IN_PROGRESS then WAITING; cancelled/completed entries may not have an active position.

customer.description: Included in barber queue list only.

service.description: Included in barber queue list only.

startAt.description: Included in barber queue list only.

endAt.description: Included in barber queue list only.

isFavorite.description: Included only for authenticated USER requests.
